readme:
# Stance

Procedural animation layers for R15 characters in Roblox.

The Animator keeps playing your keyframe animations. Stance runs right after it, every frame, and adds poses, IK and
springs on top through `Motor6D.Transform` (or `AnimationConstraint.Transform`). Nothing fights the Animator, and
there is no `C0` to restore when a layer turns off.

You write small modules ("layers"). Stance handles the loop, springs, blending, IK, and level of detail for every
character in the game.

```lua
local Posture = { name = "Posture" }

function Posture.layer(rig, out, dt, now, api)
    local speed = rig.hrp.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(rig.velocity)
    local lean = math.clamp(speed / 20, 0, 1) * math.rad(6) * api.LOD.weight(rig, "Posture", "pose")
    out.Waist += Vector3.new(-lean, 0, 0) -- Waist -X bends forward
    return lean > 0
end

return Posture
```

That is a complete layer: every character bends forward a little as it runs, the joint spring smooths it, and it
fades out with distance. Returning `false` when there's nothing to add lets the rig rest.

## Install

Stance is a single ModuleScript with no dependencies. Any of these works:

- **Wally:** add `Stance = "gabrielselvenca/stance@0.1.0"` to `[dependencies]` in `wally.toml`.
- **Model file:** download `Stance.rbxm` from [Releases](https://github.com/GabrielSelvenca/stance/releases) and drop it in
  `ReplicatedStorage`.
- **By hand:** create a ModuleScript named `Stance` and paste [`src/init.luau`](src/init.luau) into it.

Tag the characters you want animated. From a server Script:

```lua
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

game.Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        CollectionService:AddTag(character, "ProcRig")
    end)
end)
```

NPCs work the same way: tag the model.

Then start it from one LocalScript:

```lua
local Stance = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Stance) -- or ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Stance with Wally

Stance.add(game.ReplicatedStorage.Layers) -- a Folder of layer ModuleScripts, or a table
Stance.start()
```

Add every module before `start()`.

## How a frame works

1. The Animator writes the keyframe pose into each joint's `Transform`.
2. Stance reads it as the **base** of that joint.
3. The current **state** pose runs (if a module owns the state), then every **layer**, in `order`.
4. Both write into `out` (spring targets) and `rig.direct` (no spring).
5. Joint springs move toward `out`.
6. The final rotation is `base:Lerp(identity, suppress) * (spring + direct)`.

`suppress` is how much of the keyframe to hide, from 0 to 1. A layer that only adds on top returns nothing for it. A
layer that replaces the animation (a custom walk cycle, a climb) returns 1.

A rig that has nothing to do goes to rest: Stance hands the keyframe back once and stops touching it until it moves
again.

## Modules

A module is a table. Every key is optional.

| Key | Called | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `name` |
description: Procedural animation layers for R15 characters in Roblox, on top of the Animator

-- Stance: procedural animation layers for R15, on top of the Animator.
-- The Animator keeps playing keyframes; Stance adds poses, IK and springs over them every frame, with LOD.
-- Client only for start(). Requiring it on the server is safe (Pose, IK and LOD are plain functions).
-- Docs: https://github.com/GabrielSelvenca/stance
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

local Stance = {}

Stance.config = {
    tag = "ProcRig", -- characters with this tag are animated
    stiffness = 170, -- joint springs, slightly underdamped
    damping = 20,
    springs = {}, -- per joint override: { Neck = { stiffness = 250, damping = 25 } }
    -- BETA: optional joints past R15, key -> { part, joint }: { Tail = { "Tail", "TailJoint" } }.
    -- Found once when the rig is tracked (the part can be inside an Accessory); rigs without it skip it.
    extraJoints = {},
    rootMaxSpeed = math.rad(400), -- the whole body never spins faster than this
    maxDt = 1 / 20, -- springs never integrate a longer step (hitches don't explode)
    wakeSpeed = 2, -- a resting rig moving faster than this wakes up
    spinPivot = CFrame.new(0, 1, 0), -- full-body spin turns around here, relative to the Root joint
    -- Humanoid states that keep the plain keyframe (no layers)
    plainStates = {
        [Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing] = true,
        [Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming] = true,
        [Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated] = true,
    },
    -- LOD tiers: 1 Full, 2 Medium, 3 Low, 4 Off. The local player is always Full.
    enter = { 30, 80, 150 }, -- a rig enters tier n under enter[n] studs (Full/Medium also need to be on screen)
    exit = { 35, 88, 165 }, -- and leaves it above exit[n] (hysteresis)
    period = { 1, 2, 5, 5 }, -- update every N frames per tier
    maxFull = 4, -- Full slots at once, local player included; the rest drops to Medium
    budget = 2, -- ms per frame for updates; past it, the remaining rigs wait for the next frame (local player never waits)
    interval = 0.2, -- seconds between tier checks
    blend = 6, -- tier changes fade at this rate (1/s)
}

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Pose: a table of joint -> Vector3 (XYZ angles in radians; RootPos in studs)

local Pose = {}
Stance.Pose = Pose

-- { Joint = {x, y, z} } in degrees -> radians. Call once at load time.
function Pose.define(degrees)
    local pose = {}
    for key, v in degrees do
        local scale = key == "RootPos" and 1 or math.pi / 180
        pose[key] = Vector3.new(v[1], v[2], v[3]) * scale
    end
    return pose
end

function Pose.add(out, pose, w)
    if w <= 0 then
        return
    end
    for key, v in pose do
        if out[key] then -- an extra joint this rig doesn't have
            out[key] += v * w
        end
    end
end

-- 0 at a, 1 at b, smooth at both ends (a > b works, reversed)
function Pose.smoothstep(a, b, x)
    local s = math.clamp((x - a) / (b - a), 0, 1)
    return s * s * (3 - 2 * s)
end

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- IK: two-bone, solved in joint space so it stacks with the springs and the layers after it.
-- Results are absolute angles (keyframe suppressed). Use IK.relative to add them over the keyframe instead.

local IK = {}
Stance.IK = IK

-- bend: hinge side (elbow bends +X, knee -X). pole: where the elbow/knee points, in parent part space.
IK.CHAINS = {
    LArm = { root = "LShoulder", mid = "LElbow", parent = "UpperTorso", tip = "LeftHand", tipJoint = "LeftWrist", bend = -1, pole = Vector3.new(0, -0.5, 1) },
    RArm = { root = "RShoulder", mid = "RElbow", parent = "UpperTorso", tip = "RightHand", tipJoint = "RightWrist", bend = -1, pole = Vector3.new(0, -0.5, 1) },
    LLeg = { root = "LHip", mid = "LKnee", parent = "LowerTorso", tip = "LeftFoot", tipJoint = "LeftAnkle", bend = 1, pole = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) },
    RLeg = { root = "RHip", mid = "RKnee", parent = "LowerTorso", tip = "RightFoot", tipJoint = "RightAnkle", bend = 1, pole = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) },
}

local DOWN = Vector3.new(0, -1, 0)

-- C0/C1 of a Motor6D, or the attachments of an AnimationConstraint
local function frames(joint)
    if joint:IsA("Motor6D") then
        return joint.C0, joint.C1
    end
    return joint.Attachment0.CFrame, joint.Attachment1.CFrame
end
IK.frames = frames

-- Measures the bones once per rig. A limb missing a joint gets no IK.
function IK.setup(rig)
    rig.ik = {}
    for name, chain in IK.CHAINS do
        local root, mid = rig.joints[chain.root], rig.joints[chain.mid]
        local tipPart = rig.model:FindFirstChild(chain.tip)
        local tip = tipPart and tipPart:FindFirstChild(chain.tipJoint)
        local parent = rig.model:FindFirstChild(chain.parent)
        if root and mid and tip and parent then
            local rootC0, rootC1 = frames(root)
            local midC0, midC1 = frames(mid)
            local tipC0 = frames(tip)
            local upper = midC0.Position - rootC1.Position
            local lower = tipC0.Position - midC1.Position
            rig.ik[name] = {
                parent = parent, rootC0 = rootC0, rootKey = chain.root, midKey = chain.mid,
                L1 = upper.Magnitude, L2 = lower.Magnitude, bend = chain.bend, pole = chain.pole,
                -- the rest bone doesn't point straight down: fixed before aiming
                rest = CFrame.fromRotationBetweenVectors(upper.Unit, DOWN),
            }
        end
    end
end

-- Puts the limb tip (wrist / ankle) at `target` (world). Returns rootAngles, midAngles, reached.
-- Uses last frame's parent pose, so it follows the torso the springs are moving.
function IK.solve(rig, name, target, pole)
    local c = rig.ik and rig.ik[name]
    if not c then
        return nil
    end
    local joint = c.parent.CFrame * c.rootC0
    local T = joint:PointToObjectSpace(target)
    local P = c.rootC0:VectorToObjectSpace(pole or c.pole)
    local L1, L2 = c.L1, c.L2
    local length = T.Magnitude
    local dist = math.clamp(length, math.abs(L1 - L2) + 1e-3, L1 + L2 - 1e-3)
    local Tu = length > 1e-4 and T / length or DOWN
    -- bend plane holds the target and the pole
    local n = Tu:Cross(P)
    if n.Magnitude < 1e-4 then
        n = Tu:Cross(Vector3.xAxis)
        if n.Magnitude < 1e-4 then
            n = Tu:Cross(Vector3.zAxis)
        end
    end
    n = n.Unit
    -- law of cosines: angle between the target and the upper bone, leaning to the pole side
    local A = math.acos(math.clamp((L1 * L1 + dist * dist - L2 * L2) / (2 * L1 * dist), -1, 1))
    local U = Tu * math.cos(A) + n:Cross(Tu) * math.sin(A)
    local W = (Tu * dist - U * L1).Unit
    local X = n * c.bend
    local Y = -U
    local R1 = CFrame.fromMatrix(Vector3.zero, X, Y, X:Cross(Y)) * c.rest
    local D2 = R1:VectorToObjectSpace(W) -- the mid joint only bends on X
    local rx, ry, rz = R1:ToEulerAnglesXYZ()
    return Vector3.new(rx, ry, rz), Vector3.new(math.atan2(-D2.Z, -D2.Y), 0, 0), length <= L1 + L2
end

-- Absolute angles -> offset over the current keyframe of that joint
function IK.relative(rig, key, angles)
    local base = rig.base[key]
    if not base then
        return angles
    end
    local rx, ry, rz = (base.Rotation:Inverse() * CFrame.Angles(angles.X, angles.Y, angles.Z)):ToEulerAnglesXYZ()
    return Vector3.new(rx, ry, rz)
end

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- LOD: each module says up to which tier each part of it runs (module.lod)
--   pose = its pose/layer   ik = IK and detail   ray = new raycasts (0 = never; between ray and ik, reuse)

local LOD = {}
Stance.LOD = LOD

LOD.DEFAULT = { pose = 3, ik = 2, ray = 1 }
LOD.ANIMS = {} -- module name -> lod, filled by Stance.add

-- Weight of `part` of module `name` on this rig, with the tier blend. Multiply its contribution by it.
function LOD.weight(rig, name, part)
    local limit = (LOD.ANIMS[name] or LOD.DEFAULT)[part]
    return limit > 0 and rig.tierWeight[limit] or 0
end

-- May this module raycast now? Otherwise reuse the last result kept on the rig.
function LOD.canRaycast(rig, name)
    return rig.tier <= (LOD.ANIMS[name] or LOD.DEFAULT).ray
end

-- Player graphics quality scales tier distances and Full slots (level 1 -> 0.4, 7+ or automatic -> 1)
local okSettings, gameSettings = pcall(function()
    return UserSettings():GetService("UserGameSettings")
end)

function LOD.quality()
    local level = okSettings and gameSettings.SavedQualityLevel.Value or 0
    if level == 0 then
        return 1
    end
    return math.clamp(0.4 + (level - 1) * 0.1, 0.4, 1)
end

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Modules

local modules, layers, owners = {}, {}, {}
Stance.modules = modules -- sorted by order
Stance.states = {} -- state -> { module, duration, far }

local function byOrder(a, b)
    return (a.order or 50) < (b.order or 50)
end

-- A module table, or a Folder of ModuleScripts (one failing to load is skipped with a warning).
-- Add everything before start(): rigs already tracked don't run init of later modules.
function Stance.add(target)
    if typeof(target) == "Instance" then
        for _, child in target:GetChildren() do
            if child:IsA("ModuleScript") then
                local ok, module = pcall(require, child)
                if ok and type(module) == "table" then
                    Stance.add(module)
                else
                    warn("[Stance] skipped", child.Name, module)
                end
            end
        end
        return
    end
    table.insert(modules, target)
    table.sort(modules, byOrder)
    if target.name then
        LOD.ANIMS[target.name] = target.lod
    end
    for state, info in target.states or {} do
        Stance.states[state] = { module = target, duration = info.duration, far = info.far }
    end
    table.clear(layers)
    table.clear(owners)
    for _, module in modules do
        if module.layer then
            table.insert(layers, module)
        end
        if module.owner then
            table.insert(owners, module)
        end
    end
end

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Rigs

-- key -> { part, joint }. Motor6D and AnimationConstraint share .Transform
local JOINTS = {
    Root = { "LowerTorso", "Root" }, Waist = { "UpperTorso", "Waist" }, Neck = { "Head", "Neck" },
    LShoulder = { "LeftUpperArm", "LeftShoulder" }, LElbow = { "LeftLowerArm", "LeftElbow" },
    RShoulder = { "RightUpperArm", "RightShoulder" }, RElbow = { "RightLowerArm", "RightElbow" },
    LHip = { "LeftUpperLeg", "LeftHip" }, LKnee = { "LeftLowerLeg", "LeftKnee" }, LAnkle = { "LeftFoot", "LeftAnkle" },
    RHip = { "RightUpperLeg", "RightHip" }, RKnee = { "RightLowerLeg", "RightKnee" }, RAnkle = { "RightFoot", "RightAnkle" },
}
Stance.JOINTS = JOINTS

local rigs = {}
Stance.rigs = rigs
local rigByModel = {}
local localRig = nil
local nextOffset = 0

function Stance.rigOf(model)
    return rigByModel[model] or nil
end

function Stance.localRig()
    return localRig
end

-- Rig wakes up and updates again (an event turning a layer on)
function Stance.wake(rig)
    rig.resting = false
end

-- Plain state change: no network. Params is copied into rig.stateParams (non-table params are ignored here).
function Stance.setState(rig, state, params)
    local old = rig.state
    rig.state = state
    rig.t0 = os.clock()
    rig.resting = false
    rig.tierWeight[3] = rig.tier == 4 and 0 or 1 -- a rig that rested in Off didn't decay its weight
    table.clear(rig.stateParams)
    if type(params) == "table" then
        for key, value in params do
            rig.stateParams[key] = value
        end
    end
    for _, module in modules do
        if module.onStateChanged then
            -- runs outside the loop's pcall: one module failing can't stop the others
            local ok, err = pcall(module.onStateChanged, rig, old, state, Stance.api)
            if not ok then
                warn("[Stance]", module.name, err)
            end
        end
    end
end

-- What modules receive as `api`. start({ api = {...} }) adds or overrides fields (e.g. a setState that replicates).
Stance.api = { setState = Stance.setState, wake = Stance.wake, localRig = Stance.localRig, Pose = Pose, IK = IK, LOD = LOD }

local function track(model)
    if rigByModel[model] ~= nil then
        return
    end
    rigByModel[model] = false -- loading
    local humanoid = model:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
    local hrp = model:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
    local joints = {}
    for key, path in JOINTS do
        local part = model:WaitForChild(path[1], 10)
        joints[key] = part and part:WaitForChild(path[2], 10)
        if not joints[key] or not humanoid or not hrp or humanoid.RigType ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 or not model.Parent then
            rigByModel[model] = nil
            return
        end
    end
    for key, path in Stance.config.extraJoints do
        local part = model:FindFirstChild(path[1], true)
        local joint = part and part:FindFirstChild(path[2])
        if joint and (joint:IsA("Motor6D") or joint:IsA("AnimationConstraint")) then
            joints[key] = joint
        end
    end

    local _, hip1 = frames(joints.LHip)
    local knee0, knee1 = frames(joints.LKnee)
    local ankle0 = frames(joints.LAnkle)
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { model }
    local look = hrp.CFrame.LookVector
    local isLocal = Players.LocalPlayer ~= nil and model == Players.LocalPlayer.Character

    local rig = {
        model = model, humanoid = humanoid, hrp = hrp, joints = joints, params = params, isLocal = isLocal,
        thigh = (hip1.Position - knee0.Position).Magnitude, shin = (knee1.Position - ankle0.Position).Magnitude,
        -- out: spring targets. direct: added after the spring, no lag (IK has to follow the step this frame)
        base = {}, written = {}, pos = { RootPos = Vector3.zero }, vel = { RootPos = Vector3.zero },
        out = { RootPos = Vector3.zero }, direct = { RootPos = Vector3.zero },
        state = "", t0 = 0, stateParams = {},
        -- set by the game, usually in a module's init: lodTier pins the tier (nil = by distance),
        -- disabled[moduleName] = true turns a module off for this rig only
        lodTier = nil, disabled = {},
        suppress = 0, spin = 0, spinAxis = Vector3.xAxis, jitter = CFrame.identity,
        weight = 1, detail = 1, tier = isLocal and 1 or 3, dist = 0,
        -- blended weight of "tier <= 1/2/3"; others start at Low
        tierWeight = isLocal and { 1, 1, 1 } or { 0, 0, 1 },
        dtAcc = 0, offset = nextOffset, resting = true, restored = true,
        -- whoever streams in already moving doesn't start with peak acceleration/turn
        velocity = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity, accel = Vector3.zero, yaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z), turnRate = 0,
        seed = math.random() * 100,
    }
    nextOffset += 1
    for key in joints do
        rig.pos[key], rig.vel[key], rig.out[key], rig.direct[key] = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
    end
    IK.setup(rig)
    for _, module in modules do
        if module.init then
            module.init(rig)
        end
    end
    rigByModel[model] = rig
    table.insert(rigs, rig)
    if isLocal then
        localRig = rig
    end
end

local function untrack(model)
    local rig = rigByModel[model]
    rigByModel[model] = nil
    if not rig then
        return
    end
    local i = table.find(rigs, rig)
    if i then
        rigs[i] = rigs[#rigs]
        rigs[#rigs] = nil
    end
    if rig == localRig then
        localRig = nil
    end
end

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- LOD tiers

local fullList = {}
local function byDistance(a, b)
    return a.dist < b.dist
end

-- Distances are measured from here. Replace it for spectating or cutscenes (e.g. the camera position).
function LOD.origin()
    return localRig and localRig.hrp.Position or workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position
end

local function computeTiers()
    local config = Stance.config
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local origin = LOD.origin()
    local quality = LOD.quality()
    -- distances are for the default 70° field of view: zooming in counts as closer
    local zoom = math.tan(math.rad(camera.FieldOfView) / 2) / math.tan(math.rad(35))
    local maxFull = math.max(1, math.round(config.maxFull * quality))
    local enter, exit = config.enter, config.exit
    table.clear(fullList)
    for _, rig in rigs do
        if rig.isLocal then
            continue
        end
        local distance = (rig.hrp.Position - origin).Magnitude * zoom
        local _, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(rig.hrp.Position)
        local current = rig.tier
        local far = Stance.states[rig.state]
        local tier = rig.lodTier -- pinned by the game: no distance rule, no Full cap
        if not tier then
            if onScreen and distance < (current <= 1 and exit[1] or enter[1]) * quality then
                tier = 1
            elseif onScreen and distance < (current <= 2 and exit[2] or enter[2]) * quality then
                tier = 2
            elseif distance < (current <= 3 and exit[3] or enter[3]) * quality or (far and far.far) then
                tier = 3 -- off screen but near drops to Low, not Off: no pop when the camera turns
            else
                tier = 4
            end
        end
        rig.dist = distance
        if tier == 1 and not rig.lodTier and not (rig.resting and rig.state == "") then -- idle and resting takes no Full slot
            table.insert(fullList, rig)
        end
        if current == 4 and tier ~= 4 then
            rig.resting = false
            rig.dtAcc = 0 -- time spent in Off isn't a weight jump on the first update
        elseif rig.resting and current ~= 4 then
            -- resting has nothing to blend: weights follow the tier, so a rig woken by an event starts right
            for limit = 1, 3 do
                rig.tierWeight[limit] = tier <= limit and 1 or 0
            end
        end
        rig.tier = tier
    end
    if #fullList >= maxFull then
        table.sort(fullList, byDistance)
        for i = maxFull, #fullList do
            fullList[i].tier = 2
        end
    end
end

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Update (at the tier rate) and apply (every frame: the Animator rewrites Transform every frame)

local function update(rig, elapsed, now)
    local config = Stance.config
    local dt = math.min(elapsed, config.maxDt) -- derivatives use real time; springs and blends the clamped one
    local hrp = rig.hrp
    local velocity = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
    if rig.resting then
        -- resting wakes up on its own when it starts moving; asleep it still tracks velocity and heading
        if rig.tier == 4 or velocity.Magnitude < config.wakeSpeed then
            local look = hrp.CFrame.LookVector
            rig.velocity = velocity
            rig.yaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)
            return
        end
        rig.resting = false
    end

    rig.accel = rig.accel:Lerp((velocity - rig.velocity) / elapsed, 0.3)
    rig.velocity = velocity
    local look = hrp.CFrame.LookVector
    local yaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)
    local turn = (yaw - rig.yaw + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi) - math.pi
    rig.yaw = yaw
    rig.turnRate += (turn / elapsed - rig.turnRate) * math.min(1, dt * 8)

    local tierWeight = rig.tierWeight
    local blend = math.min(1, dt * config.blend)
    for limit = 1, 3 do
        tierWeight[limit] += ((rig.tier <= limit and 1 or 0) - tierWeight[limit]) * blend
    end
    rig.weight = tierWeight[3] -- base pose (gone in Off)
    rig.detail = tierWeight[2] -- IK and detail (Full/Medium)

    local out, direct = rig.out, rig.direct
    for key in out do
        out[key] = Vector3.zero
        direct[key] = Vector3.zero
    end
    local suppress, spin = 0, 0
    rig.jitter = CFrame.identity
    rig.spinAxis = Vector3.xAxis
    local disabled = rig.disabled
    local state = Stance.states[rig.state]
    if state and state.module.pose and not disabled[state.module.name] then
        suppress, spin = state.module.pose(rig, out, now - rig.t0, rig.state)
    end
    local layered = false
    if not config.plainStates[rig.humanoid:GetState()] then
        for _, module in layers do
            if disabled[module.name] then
                continue
            end
            local active, layerSuppress = module.layer(rig, out, dt, now, Stance.api)
            if active then
                layered = true
                if layerSuppress and layerSuppress > suppress then
                    suppress = layerSuppress
                end
            end
        end
    end
    rig.spin = spin or 0
    rig.suppress += ((suppress or 0) - rig.suppress) * math.min(1, dt * 10)

    local settled = rig.state == "" and rig.suppress < 0.005 and not layered
    local K, D, maxSpin = config.stiffness, config.damping, config.rootMaxSpeed
    local springs = config.springs
    local pos, vel = rig.pos, rig.vel
    for key, target in out do
        local x, v = pos[key], vel[key]
        local spring = springs[key]
        local k, d = spring and spring.stiffness or K, spring and spring.damping or D
        v += ((target - x) * k - v * d) * dt
        if key == "Root" and v.Magnitude > maxSpin then
            v = v.Unit * maxSpin
        end
        x += v * dt
        pos[key], vel[key] = x, v
        if settled and (x.Magnitude > 0.002 or v.Magnitude > 0.02) then
            settled = false
        end
    end
    if settled or (rig.tier == 4 and rig.weight < 0.01) then
        rig.resting = true
        rig.restored = false
    end
end

local function apply(rig)
    local joints, base, written = rig.joints, rig.base, rig.written
    if rig.resting then
        -- hand the keyframe back once; then the Animator runs alone
        if not rig.restored then
            for key, joint in joints do
                if base[key] and joint.Transform:FuzzyEq(written[key], 1e-4) then
                    joint.Transform = base[key]
                end
            end
            rig.restored = true
        end
        return
    end
    local w = rig.weight
    local suppress = rig.suppress * w
    local pos, direct = rig.pos, rig.direct
    local pivot = Stance.config.spinPivot
    for key, joint in joints do
        local current = joint.Transform
        -- the Animator wrote: that's the new base (fuzzy: Transform comes back with float error)
        if not written[key] or not current:FuzzyEq(written[key], 1e-4) then
            base[key] = current
        end
        local a = (pos[key] + direct[key]) * w
        local offset
        if key == "Root" then
            -- spin and jitter go after the spring, or it would filter them out
            offset = rig.jitter * CFrame.new((pos.RootPos + direct.RootPos) * w)
            local spin = rig.spin * w
            if spin ~= 0 then
                offset *= pivot * CFrame.fromAxisAngle(rig.spinAxis, spin) * pivot:Inverse()
            end
            offset *= CFrame.Angles(0, 0, a.Z) * CFrame.Angles(a.X, a.Y, 0) -- roll before pitch
        else
            offset = CFrame.Angles(a.X, a.Y, a.Z)
        end
        local final = base[key]:Lerp(CFrame.identity, suppress) * offset
        joint.Transform = final
        written[key] = final
    end
end

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Loop

local cost = 0
local lastErrorAt = 0

-- seconds per frame spent in Stance, smoothed
function Stance.cost()
    return cost
end

local function report(err)
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - lastErrorAt > 1 then
        lastErrorAt = now
        warn("[Stance]", err)
    end
end

local started = false

-- options: { tag = "ProcRig", api = { extra fields for modules }, ...any Stance.config key }
function Stance.start(options)
    assert(RunService:IsClient(), "Stance.start runs on the client")
    if started then
        return
    end
    started = true
    for key, value in options or {} do
        if key == "api" then
            for name, field in value do
                Stance.api[name] = field
            end
        else
            Stance.config[key] = value
        end
    end
    local tag = Stance.config.tag
    CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(tag):Connect(function(model)
        task.spawn(track, model)
    end)
    CollectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal(tag):Connect(untrack)
    for _, model in CollectionService:GetTagged(tag) do
        task.spawn(track, model)
    end

    local frame, lastTierAt = 0, 0
    RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function(dt)
        local start = os.clock()
        debug.profilebegin("Stance")
        frame += 1
        if start - lastTierAt >= Stance.config.interval then
            lastTierAt = start
            computeTiers()
        end
        local period = Stance.config.period
        local budget = Stance.config.budget / 1000
        local count = #rigs
        for i = 1, count do
            -- rotating start: when the budget runs out, it isn't always the same rigs that wait
            local rig = rigs[(i + frame) % count + 1]
            if rig.isLocal then
                for _, module in owners do
                    if rig.disabled[module.name] then
                        continue
                    end
                    local ok, err = pcall(module.owner, rig, dt, start, Stance.api)
                    if not ok then
                        report(err)
                    end
                end
            end
            rig.dtAcc += dt
            -- per-rig offset spreads updates across frames (no spike every N frames)
            if (frame + rig.offset) % period[rig.tier] == 0 then
                rig.due = true
            end
            if rig.due and (rig.isLocal or os.clock() - start < budget) then
                local ok, err = pcall(update, rig, rig.dtAcc, start)
                if not ok then
                    report(err)
                end
                rig.dtAcc = 0
                rig.due = false
            end
            apply(rig)
        end
        debug.profileend()
        cost += ((os.clock() - start) - cost) * 0.05
    end)
end

return Stance
